note: Campground in a state park built around 75 miles of ATV, UTV and trail-bike trails a few miles northwest of Berlin, with a beach and boat launch on Jericho Lake (no gas motors). Riders reach the trails from their sites on the campground roads. The newer full-hookup RV loop is tents-free with no facilities of its own; the bathhouse is about 0.4 mile away. --Claude
summary: RA per-site catalog: 19 full-hookup 50 A sites (30-48, 60 ft, new 2026 RV loop) plus 9 no-hookup RV sites and 10 small/tent sites; $35 base, full hookup $60; flush/showers/laundry/store; 2026 season 05-17 to 10-24. Lakeview recommended down (sites 150 m+ from the lake behind trees; RV loop below the dam). OHV base flag: the park is an OHV trail park and the campground is 'ride-in/ride-out'. hookups 0 -> 50/W/S.
flags: OHV BASE CANDIDATE (flag, not a drop; reviewer call): park page 'Jericho Mountain State Park provides opportunities for miles of trail riding for ATV, UTV, trail bike, and snowmobile enthusiasts alike ... The park also includes a 20 site ride-in/ride-out campground'; 'The campground connects to the 75 miles of OHRV trails at the park, as well as connecting with the 1000 mile of trails in Coos County'; the park also runs a 4x4 Jeep trail. RA 'ATV trail within park leading from campground'. Against: the park also has a swimming beach, boat launch and hiking (Jericho Falls), the info sheet says 'The campground is not considered an ATV riding area', and the new 19-site full-hookup RV loop (2026) is aimed at RV travellers. Reads closer to a trail-system base camp than Coleman 4113.

WATERFRONT LEAD (down): stored lakeview (not --AWH; evidence only cites commit 32ea296). The campground map puts trailer sites 10-20 in a loop north of the cabins, with Jericho Lake reached by walking trails past the toll booth; RA GIS has the nearest RV site (020, 44.50037,-71.25601) ~170 m from the lake's north shore on Esri/NAIP across woods and the day-use area. RA tags only cabins 007-009 and the pavilion 'Lake Front'. The full-hookup loop (44.4981-44.4987,-71.2503 to -71.2527) lies east of the dam ~300 m+ from the lake ('below the dam is not on the lake'). Recommend lakeview -> not waterfront. The 2019 info sheet calls it a 'lakeside campground'; marketing only.
hookups 0/false/false -> 50/true/true: the 19-site 'RV Full Hook-up Only' loop (RA rules effective 7/31/26; park page 'trial run of our new RV sites'). The main campground keeps no hookups.
